title: Conditions on Snoozing and Resuming a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
A host who cannot offer the vehicle for a while snoozes the Keyturn Vehicle Listing rather than delisting it, which keeps the listing, its history and its reviews while taking it off the calendar.

One stretch of snoozing runs no longer than the class allows, counted in whole calendar days from the day the listing was snoozed, and a listing still snoozed at the end of that stretch is resumed or delisted rather than left in between.

A listing may be snoozed no more times than the class allows over a rolling twelve months, counting stretches rather than days, so a host who snoozes repeatedly for short periods reaches the ceiling as quickly as one who snoozes twice for long ones.

Snoozing never touches a booking already confirmed, and a host who cannot honour a confirmed booking cancels it and bears the cancellation consequences rather than snoozing out of it.

The inspection clock keeps running while a listing is snoozed, so a vehicle snoozed past its interval comes back suspended rather than live.

Only the host snoozes and resumes their own listing, since the vehicle is theirs to offer or withhold. The listing is matched to the host by the listing the request is made about, and the host's own account of who they are is weighed together with the marketplace's record of whose listing it is.

### The count of stretches, read two ways

A class allowing 6 stretches in a rolling year: a host who has snoozed the vehicle six times for three days each has reached the ceiling as surely as one who has snoozed it six times for sixty days each, because what is counted is stretches and not days. A seventh stretch is not available to either of them until one of the six falls out of the rolling twelve months.
